prompts.prompt: Make a snack selector field. Users can choose Apple, Banana, or Orange, but there should also be an Other option that reveals a text input for a custom snack before applying it.
Build a media gallery that mixes images and videos. Clicking any item opens a lightbox viewer. Videos should show native playback controls. Images should support zoom on double-click.
Create a multi-step form wizard with back/next buttons and a progress indicator
Like Notion's page header with icon picker and cover image
Show a dashboard widget with loading → error → data states
Display a list of transactions with amount, date, and status indicator
Navigation that collapses to hamburger on mobile
Build a quantity selector for a shopping cart item. It should have a number input with increment/decrement, min of 1, max of 99. Changing the quantity should call an update API endpoint.
Create a new page for a settings dashboard. It should have a header with the app title, a sidebar for navigation, and a main content area. Use the Astryx theme system.
Create a profile card with the user's name as a heading, their role as a label, their bio as body text, and their join date in small supporting text
